Gf.bar_b_note: Side A's large wrapped recipe text and icon-led Craft/Leave prompts read like a shipping panel, but the dull teal box shows no teal interaction or gold progression accents, and the world behind it is a murky, flat night.

Gl.bar_b_note: The leopard-spotted newt has a strong pattern, but it stands barely trainer height, and the faint-end frame shows a stretched dark maroon rod through the body that sinks it.

Ui.bar_b_note: The cyan-violet water salamander has an on-board palette, but it is low, smaller than the 1.80 m trainer, and reads as a thin dark sliver against the stage.

Uz.bar_b_note: A naturalistic storm wolf near the Tanglevolt bar carries it, but the near-black body has little rim light to pull it off the dark stage, and the blue vein glow is faint.

Ew.bar_b_note: Side A's timber frame with brace, cap plank and stone footing reads as built, but it is still a lone card-thin panel, and the flat-shaded grey rock and painted-backdrop mountains hold the scene below Palworld finish.

Wx.bar_b_note: This is the same spotted newt as Gl, and it has the same faults: under-scaled against the trainer, and a stretched dark maroon rod in the faint-end frame.

Bm.bar_b_note: The lime-and-black camouflage blotches read as a military texture, not natural skin, the toad is no taller than the trainer, and the faint poses barely differ from standing.

Od.bar_b_note: Side B's textured white-and-blue fur wolf approaches the owner bar; side A is smooth plastic with a broken grey/black faint-end mesh and a floating faint-mid pose.

Ru.bar_b_note: The warm grandfather villager has readable eyes, a moss-green and brown palette, and a clean silhouette that fits the key art's settlement folk, though his full-body proportions read a little toy-like.

Oy.bar_b_note: The blue white-spotted water drake with tan frills has Palworld-class appeal, but the ridden frame shows no rider at all, and the faint-end tail goes rigid and straight.

Dc.bar_b_note: This is the same appealing blue drake with frills that now read tan-orange, held back by the stiff spear-straight tail and the low-lying body in the faint frames.

top_changes.change: Fix the faint and travel poses across the creature roster: the stretched maroon rod in the Gl/Wx faint end, Oy/Dc's rigid straight tails, Od A's floating faint mid, and the missing rider in Oy's ridden frame.
Rescale Ui, Bm and the Gl/Wx newt so every creature stands clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer, and add rim light so dark creatures (Uz, Ui) separate from the stage.

Repaint Bm's camouflage blotch texture into a naturalistic toad skin, keep Od B's fur material over A's, and build the homestead wall as a thick timber-frame mesh with cap and footing (Ew A direction).
